Brookline.not_found_notes: All figures from the town's FY2027 'Tax Assistance and Deferral Programs' page (/1283). workoff.income_limit: Income shall not exceed $45,000 for individual applicants or $55,000 for married applicants
workoff.signup_window: Applications accepted July 1 - August 1 (none accepted after August 1); public lottery held if oversubscribed
workoff.apply_where: Assessor's Office or Mayor's Office, Revere City Hall
workoff.quote: The program will also offer seniors the opportunity to contribute 62.5 hours within various city departments and receive a $750.00 reduction in their property tax bill.
workoff.date_or_fy: Page describes the FY2020 program (announced by Mayor Arrigo); most recent published work-off details

exemption_41c.amount_dollars: 10% of average assessed value of all residential properties (listed as $TBD on page)
exemption_41c.additional_5c_half: City adopted optional additional exemption up to 100% of the personal exemption amount (can effectively double the exemption)
exemption_41c.quote: Clause 41C 1/2 - $TBD (10% of average assessed value of all residential properties ) Age 65 as of July 1 st of the fiscal year Applicant income < $75,000

other_senior_relief.detail: In the second and subsequent years of receiving an exemption (excl. hardship), city adds up to 100% of the personal exemption amount, effectively doubling it and capping year-over-year increases.
other_senior_relief.quote: the city has adopted an optional additional exemption. The additional exemption is set at up to 100 percent of the personal exemption amount. ... So effectively this will up to double their exemption

other_senior_relief.detail: Seniors at least 65 meeting ownership/domicile rules; applicant (and spouse if married) must have gross receipts of $20,000 or less.
other_senior_relief.quote: Senior tax deferral - Seniors who are at least 65 years old, meet certain ownership and domiciliary requirements and whose annual gross receipts are within certain limits may be eligible to defer payment of their taxes. An applicant, and spouse if married must have gross receipts of $20,000 or less.

other_senior_relief.detail: $385.00 for surviving spouse / elderly; assets under $85,076.
other_senior_relief.quote: Clause 17D - $385.00 Assets < $85,076

Revere.not_found_notes: 41C1/2 (Revere's main senior exemption is Clause 41C-1/2, a means-tested local option) from the Assessors page, which links a current 'FY2027 SENIOR EXEMPTION CLAUSE 41C 1/2' application; the exemption amount is 10% of average residential assessed value (listed on page as '$TBD') and the page gives a single applicant income limit '< $75,000' with no separate married figure and no asset limit (typical of 41C1/2). WORK-OFF IS STALE: the only work-off detail page found (/mayors-office/senior-work-off) is the FY2020 announcement (2018-2019 dates); program is clearly ongoing (MGL c.59 s.5K adopted) but current-year hours/dollars/window should be confirmed - hourly_rate left null (old text implied ~$12/hr). Revere also advertises an 'Elderly & Disabled Tax Relief Program and Water Bill Relief Program' (news post) not fully verified here.

workoff.income_limit: No income limit stated on the fact sheet
workoff.signup_window: Applications accepted ahead of the live lottery drawing on November 17, 2026; credit issued on the December 2027 tax bill (min 10 hours to receive any credit)
workoff.apply_where: Town of Plymouth Human Resources Department (Chris Badot)
workoff.quote: TO OBTAIN THE MAXIMUM $1,500 CREDIT ($15.00 PER HOUR) A TOTAL OF 100 HOURS OF VOLUNTEER WORK IS REQUIRED. ... APPLICANTS MUST BE AT LEAST 60 YEARS OLD BY JANUARY 1, 2027 AND/OR A VETERAN (ANY AGE) ... PARTICIPANTS ARE RANDOMLY SELECTED BY LOTTERY
workoff.date_or_fy: 2027 program (volunteer work in 2026; credit on Dec 2027 tax bill)

exemption_41c.clause: 41D (Plymouth adopted Clause 41D, the inflation-adjusted alternative to 41C)
exemption_41c.deadline: Applications are accepted after Columbus Day to April 1, each year
exemption_41c.quote: Total Gross Income $27,445.00 (Single) $40,890.00 (Married) ... Applicant's estate (excluding the value of your domicile) cannot exceed: Single: $42,559 Married: $58,519 ... The Amount of the Exemption is $1,000 Per Year.
exemption_41c.date_or_fy: Fiscal year not stated on page (figures appear current)

other_senior_relief.detail: Elderly who don't fully meet Clause 41D requirements may get lesser assistance under Clause 17E/17F, or defer taxes under Clause 41A (deferral until the home is sold or the owner dies).
other_senior_relief.quote: If applicant is elderly but does not meet one or all of the Clause 41D requirements, he/she may be eligible for a lesser amount of assistance under Clause 17E /17F or a tax deferral under Clause 41A.

Plymouth.not_found_notes: Plymouth's main senior exemption is Clause 41D (NOT 41C) - the inflation-adjusted local option; figures ($1,000; single total gross income $27,445 / married $40,890; assets $42,559 / $58,519) from the Elderly Exemption Clause 41D page (/183), which does not label a fiscal year. Deadline 'after Columbus Day to April 1' from Property Tax Exemptions page (/181). Work-off is the combined 'Senior & Veterans Property Tax Work Off Program' (2027 cycle) run by Human Resources; no income limit is stated; slots_limited=true (lottery + mandatory background checks).
